mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fence (tenant_id, name, center_lat, center_lon, enter_radius_m, exit_radius_m) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{request.name}, #{request.centerLat}, #{request.centerLon}, #{request.enterRadiusM}, #{request.exitRadiusM})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, name, center_lat, center_lon, enter_radius_m, exit_radius_m, version, deleted FROM fence WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE fence SET name = #{request.name}, center_lat = #{request.centerLat}, center_lon = #{request.centerLon}, enter_radius_m = #{request.enterRadiusM}, exit_radius_m = #{request.exitRadiusM}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = false
UPDATE fence SET deleted = true, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (tenant_id, topic, msg_key, payload) VALUES (#{tenantId}, 'fence-changes', #{id}, #{payload})
